violations.text: Desserts and calzones were observed held between 46-50 degrees Fahrenheit in the 1 door reach-in. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All food in unit was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. 1 door reach-in was observed holding an ambient of 46 DF at the beginning of inspection. Unit was adjusted and observed holding an ambient temperature of 40 DF. Establishment is to monitor the temperature of 1 door reach-in and ensure that it is able to keep an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
